displayIdentity.body: Grace is answered through endurance and paradox. Working together, we entreat also that you do not receive the grace of God in vain. as sorrowful yet always rejoicing, as poor yet making many rich, as having nothing and yet possessing all things.
displayIdentity.title: Grace is answered through endurance and paradox
